ns2:course.label: Nanophotonics
ns2:course.description: Nanoscale interaction between light and semiconductors, metals, or composites; plasmonics, cavity electrodynamics, polarition cavity condensation, sub-wavelength structures, metamaterials, and applications. Prerequisite: ECE 455 or ECE 572; ECE 487 or PHYS 486.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ECE 455 or ECE 572; ECE 487 or PHYS 486.
